_readme: FEAT-157 — Orchard's numbered base releases. APPEND-ONLY: never edit or remove an entry.
Each entry freezes a base recipe: its snapshot is releases/v{version}/{Dockerfile,provision.json},
and 'hash' is recipeHash() of that snapshot (src/server/provisioning.ts). A project pins a version
(settings.container.base.pinned) and is told about newer ones on its Needs-You rail; nothing moves
it silently except a 'security' release, which is applied at the next launch with no live session.
Cut a release with: npm run base:release -- --class=feature|fix|security --summary='…' --adjust='…'
A security release must also name at least one --verify=<package>:<min-version> (checked with
dpkg --compare-versions inside the built image), and is built with --no-cache --pull.
projects pinned to 'dev' until it is cut as a release.

releases.summary: First numbered base (Ubuntu 24.04, Node 20, Python 3, uv, Serena 1.7.0, Playwright MCP 0.0.79 + Chromium, docker CLI). The Claude CLI is no longer baked into the base: Orchard adds the host's CLI as a thin layer on top, so a pinned base never freezes an old CLI.
releases.adjust: Nothing to change in a project Dockerfile that builds FROM ${ORCHARD_BASE_IMAGE}. Do not install or pin the Claude CLI yourself; Orchard layers the version this host needs on top of your image. Moving from a legacy base to v1 recreates the container once, at the next launch with no live session.
